$comment: THE ONE pivot style preset source (ruling R3, WP-C S10b). Read by the Pivot extension (styles/excelPivotStyles.ts, rendering/pivot.ts DEFAULT_PIVOT_THEME) AND by the backend (app/src-tauri/src/pivot/grid_theme.rs include_str!), so the box and the hidden grid -- and therefore a copy -- wear the same colours. Each style's element definitions are Excel's; its `theme` is the PivotTheme colours the box paints with, derived from the elements by the rule pinned in Pivot/lib/__tests__/pivotStyles.test.ts (legacyOverrides). A new style must carry its `theme`; that test prints the expected object. `fallbackTheme` is what a style id the catalogue does not know paints with. Drift: Pivot/__tests__/pivotStyleSourceDrift.test.ts and grid_theme.rs tests.
